items.title: if your team is too busy doing their 'normal job' to experiment with AI, you're preparing them to be replaced
items.summary: When Ralph was published last year, I sat on it. People who have been reading this blog for a while know this. I first came across the idea of loop engineering in early January last year, sat on it for four months, and then started writing a lot, begging people to pay attention. Dear Student: Yes...
